tools.name: recommend_events
tools.description: Personal picks from the published Knossot calendar for a brief, in one region and a window of up to 14 days. Up to 3 picks on the free weekly run, up to 5 on credits ($0.075 per run, charged only when picks come back). Repeating the same arguments in the same ten-minute window replays the earlier pi

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: This key's spending limit, whether the free weekly run is still available, and the credit balance.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: The four regions with their towns, the category ids recommend_events accepts, and the run limits. Needs no key.
